themes.name: 无法确定
themes.problem: 无法确定具体技术手段

evidence.quote: PURPOSE:To adopt a simple mechanism of a center resist system for feeding copying paper and to make the setting of an original easy, by providing a means for detecting original sizes and a means for moving the original up to the center of platen glass in accordance with the information on the original size.

PURPOSE:To detect exactly an existence of an original by setting a photodetecting signal which has received directly light of a face-shaped light emitting body provided on a platen cover, as a reference value, and comparing this value with a photodetecting signal received through the original on a platen.

PURPOSE:To move the picture of optional part of a transparent original placed on a stage, to the center of the stage by forming a roughly U-shaped bent part projecting to the outside from a machine body, on the lower part of a support, and forming the upper face of the lower wall of this bent part to the almost same plane as the upper face of the machine body.

analysis.heterogeneity: 该聚类包含多种不同技术领域，如复印机原稿定位、图像投影仪、原稿尺寸检测等，技术手段差异较大。
analysis.limitations: 由于缺乏明确的技术特征描述，无法准确归类为单一技术主题。
